:::{#thm-whitening-inner-product}
#### A matrix-induced inner product is a dot product of transformed vectors

Let $\matr{A}$ be a $p \times p$ symmetric positive definite matrix (@def-positive-definite).
Then $\matr{A} = \tp{\matr{W}}\matr{W}$ for some invertible $p \times p$ matrix $\matr{W}$,
and for all $\vx, \vy \in \reals^p$,

$$
\iprod{\vx}{\vy}_{\matr{A}} = (\matr{W}\vx) \cdot (\matr{W}\vy).
$$

:::

::: proof

By the Cholesky factorization (@thm-cholesky), $\matr{A} = \matr{L}\tp{\matr{L}}$
with $\matr{L}$ lower triangular with positive diagonal entries,
so $\matr{W} = \tp{\matr{L}}$ is invertible and $\matr{A} = \tp{\matr{W}}\matr{W}$.
Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
\iprod{\vx}{\vy}_{\matr{A}} &= \tp{\vx} \tp{\matr{W}}\matr{W} \vy \\
&= \tp{(\matr{W}\vx)} (\matr{W}\vy) \\
&= (\matr{W}\vx) \cdot (\matr{W}\vy).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
